judgments.evidence: src/declare.jl:652 `function y_state end` and :684 `function y_direct end` are plain generic functions. Probe P001 shows typeof(Redstone.y_state) <: Function, with 79 y_state and 50 y_direct methods added by ordinary method definitions.

src/store.jl:102-129: scatter_group! is @generated. It compares the return's NamedTuple key set and field types against the declared cells at generation, so a conformant return compiles to plain stores and a non-conformant one to a throw. src/executor.jl:170 runs it on every stage evaluation, and src/leaves.jl:400-431 does the same for x_deriv and s_update writes through flatten_state!.
judgments.note: For a bare contract or bare store (D-437, D-438) the check generated at store.jl:133-145 and leaves.jl:441-455 compares the bare return type, not a NamedTuple type. The substance holds: the check runs on every evaluation, is decided at generation and costs nothing when conformant. The 'NamedTuple-type' wording covers only the named form.

judgments.evidence: src/declare.jl:855-874 bundle_names derives the bundle's fields from the declarations alone. x/s/m appear when the store declarations return a value, u when u_types is non-empty and y when y_types is non-empty. ws, t and Δt are added by fixed rules. src/executor.jl:117-143 builds NamedTuple{BN} from the BN type parameter. The nested u/y key sets are the u_types/y_types keys (gather over entry.inputs/entry.y).
judgments.note: Read as 'the bundle's key sets are fixed by the contract declarations', not as literal equality: the top-level keys are store letters plus u/y/ws/t/Δt. Under a bare contract (D-436) u or y is the value itself and has no key set.

judgments.evidence: src/build.jl:1059 calls invoke_declaration(ws_init, comp, T or Float64) to allocate the workspace that the entry holds as `ws` (src/executor.jl:136). Nothing derives an entry type from its declared keys. src/declare.jl:142-148: 'The framework calls the allocator'.
judgments.note: src/conditions.jl:664-665 also calls ws_init, only to tell a workspace field apart in an undeclared-field diagnostic. That use reads its keys for a message and derives no schema.

judgments.evidence: src/structure.jl:534-537 runs foreign_declarations and throws DeclarationShadowed at the start of _walk!, before classify(path, comp) at :538. _walk! recurses into every child (:582). Probe P034 shows a shadowed child under a passthrough parent caught at its own path `kid`, and P039 shows the check firing at the root.

src/diagnostics.jl:574-578. Probe P039 prints: "`c`: its module `Main.ForgottenImport.Update` defines its own `x_deriv`, distinct from `Redstone.x_deriv`; add `import Redstone: x_deriv` (§8.1)". The message opens with the component path and then names the module. It never takes the spec's "`MyEngine`'s module …" form.
judgments.fix: Its message reads "`engine`: its module `MyEngine` defines its own `x_deriv`, distinct from `Redstone.x_deriv`; add `import Redstone: x_deriv`".
judgments.note: The code has used the 'path: its module `M`' template since it first landed (b6793373, then spelled with Cadence). The spec quote came in with the ruling 351e6440 and was reworded in ef7f5dd8. D-246 (design/log.md:10084) gives no exact wording, so no entry backs the spec's text. The path `engine` in the fix is an illustrative value.

judgments.evidence: src/declare.jl:757-761 foreign_declarations reads only module-level bindings (isdefined/getfield on parentmodule). src/roster.jl:141-159 defines `claims(b::AbstractBinding)` as part of the binding contract, with an error-throwing fallback. attach! calls it once. src/bindings.jl:94 shows a shipped binding's method.
